body: Orchestrator note for the sweep: run `npm test` with DM_DESKTOP_PIPE and DM_SESSION_TOKEN UNSET. With them set (as in orchestrator/agent shells launched by the desktop), src/mcp/tools/chatNaming.test.ts reaches the LIVE desktop app, fails expecting desktop_unavailable, and actually renames a real chat to 'Intent label' (observed by the DM-187 reviewer). Consider making the test hermetic (strip those variables in the test harness) so it can never touch a live app.
